main.label: 磁盘总余量
main.command:
_disk_rows=$(
for _disk_path in '/' '/data'; do
    if [ "$_disk_path" != / ]; then mountpoint -q -- "$_disk_path" 2>/dev/null || continue; fi
    _disk_device=$(stat -Lc '%d' -- "$_disk_path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
